title_suffix: radix-distributed sparse-union schedule on PR1673's capped phase-cell fusion outer (Le Gall tau=2.372864, PR1699) on the pivot-566+554 T74 supplier
summary: Capped phase-cell fusion outer (PR1673, Vlado Vojdanovski) on this repository's T74 supplier (pivot-566 and pivot-554 helper-donor kernels, certified complex endpoint 0.00167975495612554452133567...), with the matrix boundary at tau=2.372864 above Francois Le Gall's published omega<2.3728639 as specialised by Chafik Boukhalfa in PR1699, free strict slacks at 1e-64 or below and b = certified endpoint - 1e-64, and a NEW radix-distributed sparse-union schedule (outer/UNION-SCHEDULE.md, not part of PR1673 or PR1699; executable check outer/sched_test.py) that replaces the per-axis scan of the union by flag-count rounds with stable radix distribution, a variable-length lockstep transpose and a LIFO interleave: union row eps+1/2-xi instead of eps+beta+1/2-xi, so the boundary row binds with main = fused Gaussian. The 50 strict inequalities, 7 rejecting controls (including reinstating the old g-factor union row, which fails) and the endpoint rejection are regenerated with an independent balance derivation; the supplier's full native admission is rerun. Conditional, with all inherited all-size hypotheses; the union schedule needs independent review; the exponent is a cited theorem.
credits: PR1673 (Vlado Vojdanovski, with AI assistance): capped phase-cell fusion outer construction, its proof and exact evidence, vendored verbatim under vendor/pr1673. Chafik Boukhalfa (PR1699: classical-matrix specialisation of PR1673's boundary) and Francois Le Gall (omega<2.3728639, Powers of Tensors and Fast Matrix Multiplication, ISSAC 2014). The radix-distributed sparse-union schedule is new in this package; its independent review simulation outer/sched_review.py is by LeverRank. Research direction, prioritisation and release strategy: jeremykothe2. Implementation assistance: oh-my-pi.
